diagnosis: Proliferative nodule in congenital melanocytic naevus
legend: A compound giant congenital naevus is observed with multiple proliferative nodules with sharp demarcation from surrounding congenital naevus cells.

diagnosis: Proliferative nodule in congenital melanocytic naevus
legend: Higher magnification of the proliferative nodule shows slightly enlarged epithelioid melanocytes with visible nucleoli and occasional mitotic activity but a lack of high-grade nuclear atypia.

diagnosis: Proliferative nodule in congenital melanocytic naevus
legend: A nodular proliferation consisting of monomorphic small round blue cells filling and expanding the dermis is observed.
